name: heal.dev
description: Runtime bug and vulnerability hunter. It learns how to run your app in a production-like sandbox, hunts for bugs, security holes and performance issues that code review misses, and files only what it can reproduce, each with a failing test your coding agent can fix.

name: Recursive Flint
description: Free, open-weight coding model built to run locally on a laptop. A 40B mixture-of-experts model with 2.5B active parameters, it runs over 125 tokens/sec on an M4 Pro MacBook and works with Ollama, LM Studio and llama.cpp, so you can code offline with no API fees.

name: Mistral Voxtral 3
description: Mistral's new speech family: Voxtral TTS 3 text-to-speech with voice cloning and emotion and pace tags, fast multilingual transcription, and a real-time voice agent SDK. Useful for NPC voices, narration and voice-driven game or app features via API.
pricingNote: Usage-based API, Voxtral TTS 3 is $13 per 1M characters

name: Animatica
description: Blender add-ons for character animation. Marionette lets you pose a humanoid by dragging a hand or foot while an offline pose model moves the rest of the body, then clean up sliding feet and jitter. Choreographer generates motion from prompts. Works with Rigify, Auto-Rig Pro and Mixamo rigs.
pricingNote: Choreographer free (10 cloud generations/mo), Marionette $59 one-time

name: Vercel fx
description: Open-source coding agent from Vercel Labs, written in Zig and built to be scripted or embedded. A tiny native binary with JSON output for scripts and CI, Agent Client Protocol support for editors, and a JS/WebAssembly library.

name: Composio
description: Gives AI agents and coding agents managed-auth access to 1,500+ app toolkits (GitHub, Slack, Notion and more) through SDKs, a CLI and an MCP gateway. The new Composio Instant lets agents pay for paid tools on their own.
pricingNote: Free Hobby plan (100,000 tool calls/mo), Pro $29/mo

name: Beacon
description: Open-source memory layer for coding agents. It captures sessions from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ other tools, then turns fixes and workflows into reusable skills any agent can load.
pricingNote: Open source (MIT) and a free cloud tier, Cloud Pro $20/mo billed annually

name: Reticle
description: Makes your coding agent verify its own work: it drives the running app, reads network calls, app state and console, and returns a pass, fail or can't-tell verdict with the file and line to fix.
pricingNote: Open-source SDK (Apache-2.0) and engine, hosted platform free to start, paid pricing not published

name: Phonon
description: Gradium's open-weight text-to-speech, small enough to run offline on phones, laptops, browsers and a Raspberry Pi, with 100+ built-in voices in English, French, German, Spanish and Portuguese. Handy for in-game character voices.
pricingNote: 31m English model is Apache-2.0; 40m and multilingual models are CC BY-NC (commercial use via Gradium sales)

name: Zetta 3D
description: Turns a prompt, a photo or several reference views into game-ready 3D models with clean geometry, PBR textures, collision shapes and physics properties. It now also makes Gaussian splats from images or video (paid plans, early access).
pricingNote: Free tier with 140 one-off credits, paid plans from €5/mo

name: Cursor
description: AI-first code editor built on VS Code with intelligent autocomplete, chat, and code generation capabilities.

name: GitHub Copilot
description: AI pair programmer that offers code suggestions directly in your editor, powered by OpenAI.

name: Zed
description: High-performance code editor with built-in AI assistance, real-time collaboration, and Rust-powered speed.

name: Tabnine
description: AI code assistant now part of Tricentis, offering enterprise-grade code completion and security features.

name: Replit
description: Browser-based IDE with AI assistant for coding, debugging, and deploying apps instantly.

name: Bolt
description: Full-stack web development platform with AI that writes, runs, and deploys code in the browser.

name: v0
description: AI-powered UI generation tool by Vercel that creates React components from text prompts.

name: Lovable
description: AI software engineer that builds full-stack web applications from natural language descriptions.

name: Claude
description: Advanced AI assistant by Anthropic with strong coding capabilities and long context windows.

name: ChatGPT
description: OpenAI's conversational AI with code interpreter, image generation, and plugin ecosystem.

name: Devin
description: Autonomous AI software engineer that can plan, code, debug, and deploy entire projects.

name: Qodo
description: AI-powered code review and governance platform that generates tests and enforces coding standards.

name: Sourcegraph Cody
description: AI coding assistant with deep codebase understanding and context-aware suggestions.

name: CodeRabbit
description: AI code reviewer that provides contextual feedback on pull requests with actionable suggestions.

name: Greptile
description: AI-powered code review that understands your entire codebase to catch bugs and security issues.

name: Midjourney
description: Leading AI image generator known for artistic, high-quality visuals through Discord.

name: DALL-E 3
description: OpenAI's latest image generation model with improved prompt understanding and detail.

name: Leonardo AI
description: AI image generation platform tailored for game assets, characters, and concept art.

name: Scenario
description: AI-powered creative production platform with 650+ models for game art, video, 3D, and audio.

name: Stable Diffusion
description: Open-source image generation model that can run locally with various fine-tuned versions.

name: Pixel Lab
description: AI tool specifically designed for generating pixel art sprites, animations, and game assets.

name: Meshy
description: AI 3D model generator that creates textured, print-ready models from text prompts or images.

name: Luma AI
description: AI creative platform for video, image, and 3D generation with photorealistic quality.

name: Kaedim
description: Transform 2D images into production-ready 3D models for games and applications.

name: Tripo AI
description: Fast AI-powered text-to-3D and image-to-3D model generation with high quality output.

name: Spline AI
description: 3D design tool with AI features for generating objects, textures, and interactive web experiences.

name: Suno
description: AI music generator that creates full songs with vocals from text prompts.

name: Udio
description: Create high-quality AI-generated music in any style with realistic vocals.

name: Soundraw
description: AI music generator for creating royalty-free background music trained only on in-house productions.

name: ElevenLabs
description: Industry-leading AI voice synthesis with realistic speech, voice cloning, and music generation.

name: Murf AI
description: AI voice platform with ultra-fast TTS API for voice agents and studio-quality voiceovers.

name: Inworld AI
description: Models and inference for consumer AI apps: realtime TTS, STT, speech-to-speech, and LLM hosting.

name: Resemble AI
description: Multimodal deepfake detection and AI voice watermarking platform for enterprise security.

name: Charisma.ai
description: Immersive conversational AI platform for interactive training scenarios and brand experiences.

name: NovelAI
description: AI storytelling and anime image generation tool for narrative content and world-building.

name: Sudowrite
description: AI writing assistant for creative fiction with story generation, editing, and visualization tools.

name: Runway
description: AI-powered creative platform for video generation, editing, and real-world intelligence research.

name: Pika
description: AI creative platform with multiple models for video generation, image editing, and audio scoring.

name: HeyGen
description: Create AI avatar videos with lifelike digital twins for marketing and training content.

name: Synthesia
description: Enterprise AI video platform with realistic avatars for training and marketing videos.

name: Descript
description: AI-powered video and podcast editor with transcription and text-based editing.

name: Jasper
description: AI marketing platform for generating copy, blog posts, and social media content.

name: Copy.ai
description: GTM AI platform for sales prospecting, content creation, and lead processing workflows.

name: Writesonic
description: AI writer for marketing content, landing pages, and SEO-optimized articles.

name: Hypotenuse AI
description: AI content platform for e-commerce product descriptions and marketing copy.

name: Anyword
description: AI copywriting with predictive performance scores for marketing content.

name: LangChain
description: Open agent platform for building, testing, deploying, and monitoring LLM applications.

name: AutoGPT
description: AI team platform with specialized experts for content, sales, research, and automation tasks.

name: CrewAI
description: Enterprise agent build and runtime platform for orchestrating multi-agent workflows.

name: Semantic Kernel
description: Microsoft's SDK for integrating LLMs into applications with plugins and planners.

name: Haystack
description: Open-source AI orchestration framework for building production-ready agents and RAG pipelines.

name: Vercel AI SDK
description: TypeScript toolkit for building AI applications and agents with streaming support.

name: OpenCode
description: Open-source AI coding agent that works in your terminal, desktop app or IDE, with free models included or any provider's models.
pricingNote: Open source, free models included or bring your own

name: Epherem
description: Free source-code security scanner for AI-built apps with 55 checks for exposed keys, open database tables, missing login and ownership checks, and unsafe input.
pricingNote: Free during early access (5 scans a day)

name: Ludo.ai
description: AI game asset suite for sprites, 2D assets, 3D models, audio and video. The new Ludo CLI (Oct 2026) lets you or coding agents like Claude Code generate assets straight into your project from the terminal, alongside its API and MCP on Pro plans.
pricingNote: Free credits to start, Indie $15/mo, Pro $35/mo (billed annually)

name: Thrixel
description: Text- and image-to-3D generator that outputs structured assets with labelled parts, usable in the browser or from coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

name: Fish Audio
description: Expressive text-to-speech and voice cloning with emotion tags, powered by its Drama 3 voice model.

name: Mirelo
description: Video-to-sound AI that generates footsteps, impacts, foley and ambience synced to your video while keeping dialogue. SFX 2.0 (Oct 2026) designs a full, consistent soundtrack across clips of any length and is also on Runway and fal.

name: Framefields
description: Open-source, code-first video engine for coding agents: write motion graphics, type, 3D and audio in TypeScript and render frame-accurate MP4s on the GPU, no headless browser.

name: Effigy
description: Fully local pipeline that turns a prompt or image into a textured, rigged and animated 3D model, plus sprite sheets and pixel art, exported to Godot, Unreal or Unity.
pricingNote: Open source (MIT), runs locally on a 16 GB NVIDIA GPU

name: Harness
description: Open-source command center that runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and other coding agents side by side across all your machines, each on its own git worktree.
pricingNote: Open source (MIT), free app on Mac and Linux

name: Hy Memory
description: Tencent Hunyuan's open-source memory framework and MemHub app that give agents long-term memory, including shared coding history across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and OpenCode.

name: NitroStack
description: Platform for building, testing and deploying MCP servers and AI apps, with open-source TypeScript and Python SDKs, a visual Studio and one-step cloud deploys.
pricingNote: Open-source SDK and CLI, free tokens to start, paid pricing not published

name: Vercel
description: Git-connected hosting for web apps and Next.js sites, with automatic preview deploys, serverless functions and a global CDN.
pricingNote: Free Hobby plan for personal, non-commercial use; Pro $20/mo per developer seat

name: Netlify
description: Deploy sites and web apps from Git, an AI agent or the API, with unlimited deploy previews, functions and custom domains with SSL.
pricingNote: Free plan with 300 credits/mo; Personal $9/mo, Pro $20/mo

name: Cloudflare Pages
description: Fast static and full-stack site hosting on Cloudflare's global network, deployed from Git or the Wrangler CLI. ToolDrop runs on it.
pricingNote: Free plan: unlimited sites, requests and bandwidth, 500 builds/mo

name: Railway
description: Deploy backends, databases, workers and full-stack apps from a repo or Docker image, billed per second for what you use.
pricingNote: Free plan with $1/mo usage credit (plus a $5 30-day trial); Hobby $5/mo, Pro $20/mo

name: Render
description: Host web services, static sites, Postgres, Redis-compatible key value stores and cron jobs with auto-deploys from Git.
pricingNote: Free Hobby workspace with free web service and Postgres tiers; Pro $25/mo plus compute

name: Pando
description: Open-source, self-hosted platform for deploying AI-built apps behind sign-in, with security scans and isolated networks per app. Early-stage.

name: itch.io
description: Upload and sell indie games, including playable browser games, with a pay-what-you-want model and no hosting fees.
pricingNote: Free to use; you choose the revenue share (open revenue sharing)

name: Summer Engine
description: AI-native 2D/3D game engine built on Godot, where the built-in Summer Agent or any MCP coding agent builds scenes and scripts, generates 3D models, art, music and SFX, tests gameplay and exports to desktop, web and mobile.
pricingNote: Free app with 5 AI messages a day and free MCP; Pro $20/mo, Pro+ $60/mo, Ultra $200/mo

name: Kling AI
description: AI video generator whose Kling 4.0 model makes native 30-second clips with up to 10 keyframes, multimodal references, stereo sound effects and multilingual lip sync. The 4.0 API opened to developers on Oct 21 2026. Good for trailers and cutscenes.
pricingNote: Free Basic plan (watermarked exports); paid credit plans

name: 3D AI Studio
description: Text- and image-to-3D studio that bundles several 3D models (including Meshy, Tripo and Rodin) with AI texturing, rigging, image editing and an MCP connector. Its Oct 20 2026 update added voice prompts to the Flow canvas.
pricingNote: Free Basic plan with 1,000 credits/mo; paid Studio and Pro plans

name: BAND
description: Shared chat rooms where your coding agents and teammates work together, with governance and audit built in. The Band Desktop app lets you watch and coordinate local coding agents in one workspace.
pricingNote: Free for personal non-commercial use (up to 20 agents); Pro $17.99/mo
